A rotation the registry cannot produce is therefore no longer reachable by governance alone, which is the intended cost.

evidence_updates.change: Re-derived every declared insertion for the configuration contract, from fifteen to seventeen. The loader no longer refuses; it parses and publishes what it found. A named requirement refuses instead, and is asked by the elected-set installation, the registry update, the account's own tick-tock, an accepted proposal and a message signed by the configuration key. Two parameters are exempt, and only while the checkpoint is missing: deactivation and this contract's code, which install on the normal vote alone. The closed set of validator-set parameters widened from three indices to the whole group of six.
evidence_updates.scope: Declared additive insertions only. The contract still preserves every historical byte: the one original line this touches, which marks the loader impure, is declared as a seven-byte insertion rather than an amendment, so the production baseline is unchanged. No wire, API, schema, operation, role, limit or profile value changes, and the profile revision is unchanged.
evidence_updates.reason: Refusing in the loader mixed two different requirements. That an account with no checkpoint must not go on producing authenticated state is right; that it must also become unreadable and unrepairable is not, and it turns one bad state into a permanent one. Fail-closed means no new state the chain would treat as authenticated -- not that the fault cannot be observed or ended. The recovery surface is narrow and writes no checkpoint, because a recovery that seeded one would be the second initialization route this design exists to remove. And the parameter group widened because parameter 35 is read in preference to 34 by both the node and committee derivation, so closing 34 alone left the same fact reachable under its second spelling.
evidence_updates.governance: A chain whose registry context cannot open may still stop being an authenticated chain, or replace this contract's code, on the normal vote alone. That is a deliberate relaxation of the two-stage rule in exactly that state and in no other: the governing quorum the second stage consults is precisely what such a chain has no way to reach, so requiring it for the two operations that end the state would leave no way out of it at all.

Parameter 8 was treated as a recovery by its number, so a Config8 that left the chain authenticated passed as one and took both the checkpoint requirement and the governing quorum with it. And parameter 0 writes no validator set, so no rule about 32 to 37 reached it, while collation follows it to another account and takes that account's whole dictionary -- a dictionary whose validator set nothing proves the registry decided.
evidence_updates.governance: Freezing parameter 0 while active removes the ability to redirect the configuration contract on a live authenticated chain. Replacing this contract's logic does not need it: a code upgrade keeps the dictionary and so keeps the set the registry decided, while a redirect replaces every parameter at once with no per-parameter rule applied to any of them. The two were never the same authority.
evidence_updates.unclosed: Requiring registry binding in the collation-time validator of a replacement dictionary remains the rule in the right place and is not written: that validator has no registry to ask there. Parameter 0 stays frozen rather than guarded by a check that cannot see what it would have to check.

evidence_updates.authorization: The owner authorized reopening the validator manager for phase-one admission integration only, and asked that the manager stop applying a subset of the committee rules and consume the derived committee once an independently established anchor was available to it.
evidence_updates.change: Re-derived the manager's declared insertion. Its session gate now derives the committee a validator group would run under, using the node's own applied masterchain block as the anchor and the chain context the node established from its own zero state, and requires the roster it would seat to be the one derivation selects. The subset it applied before admitted a roster carrying a binding no registry ever issued, which derivation refuses -- not an unauthenticated chain but a stalled one, with two admissions giving opposite answers about one set. A missing chain context refuses the shard rather than checking less. The gate cannot be instantiated by any test here, so its shape is read by a new check with its own negative controls, and the rules it applies are exercised through the confirmation's own suite and mutations.

evidence_updates.authorization: Reviewed as a P0 operational blocker: the chain context the session gate requires is established by an asynchronous read, group creation was not waiting on it, and nothing drove a second attempt once it arrived. The owner asked for group creation to depend on both startup conditions and for a failed read to be retried rather than terminal.
evidence_updates.change: Re-derived the manager's declared insertion. A session refused because the chain context had not arrived is remembered, and whichever of the two startup conditions arrives last creates it -- never before the cleanup records are loaded, and never when nothing was refused. Group creation is otherwise driven by a new masterchain block, so on a chain whose validators are all refusing, the block that would drive the next attempt is the one none of them is producing: the previous shape could not start such a chain at all. A failed zero-state read now retries with an interval that doubles to a ceiling, bounded in rate rather than in attempts, because one transient archive error otherwise left a node unable to validate until it was restarted. The decision is one object with its own cases and mutations rather than flags read in three places.

evidence_updates.authorization: The owner asked to close the remaining chain-context retry/backoff issue: admission must not bypass a scheduled backoff, only one delayed retry may exist, and a stale timer must not consume the current retry.
evidence_updates.change: Re-derived the manager insertion.
